_description: Anatomical reconstruction: fit the neural shape models to one knee's segmentation meshes and build its subject-specific OpenSim model. One reconstruction per knee serves every gait condition.

run._note: The run placeholder is filled with the run the data root declares (its _run.json). The models a run builds live under 01_models/<run>/, beside the saved fits it rebuilds from.

inputs._saved_fits_note: rebuild only: the knee's existing reconstruction, whose saved shape-model fit (latents, alignment, decoded surfaces) is built from again without refitting. Must differ from run.output_dir. These are the v2 run's fits; a new data root links them in read-only (python -m comak_knee_oa.new_root link --root <root> 01_models/OARSI_May.22.2026_Full_run).

reconstruction._note: Fitting is seeded (Python, NumPy, PyTorch, CUDA); a refit is still not bit-identical, because the GPU backward pass and mesh extraction vary, so reconstructions are compared by surface distance. The shape models fit at 20k sampled points per surface with similarity registration.
reconstruction._meniscus_center_note: Origin of the radial trim applied to each meniscus contact surface. midline: one point midway between the tibial plateau centres (tibia_labeled_v2.vtk). as_run: one point per meniscus, the centroid of its centre label on the labelled tibia, as the v2 models were built. The two give contact surfaces that agree to within a few percent of their area.
reconstruction._fatpad_clearance_note: Direction of the rays that stop the prefemoral fat pad short of the patella. dilation_normals: along the direction the fat pad is grown. auto_oriented: along normals recomputed on the open bone patch, which in about half of knees point into the bone, so the patella never limits the fat pad; nsosim's default when the key is absent, and how the v2 models were built.

material_properties._note: The patellar tendon is stiffened to four times its literature default to keep the patellofemoral joint stable through gait. The prefemoral fat pad is a soft elastic contact 10 mm thick.
